name: Lina Gálvez - § 1, point aa - Am 8
title: REPORT on a European Parliament recommendation to the Council concerning the EU priorities for the 70th session of the UN Commission on the Status of Women
part_text: (aa) strongly condemn all forms of sexual violence; stress that women have the fundamental right to live in safety in their country of origin, free from violence, persecution or discrimination; reaffirm the right of women and girls subjected to acts of persecution owing to gender-based violence to receive effective access to justice;
